name: dom-highlight-tool
description: Bookmarklet for highlighting DOM elements and capturing screenshots
author: ffooll-bit

scripts.build: terser highlight-tool.js -o highlight-tool.min.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version;const m=fs.readFileSync('highlight-tool.min.js','utf8');if(!m.includes(v)){console.error('Version mismatch: VERSION in highlight-tool.js does not match package.json ('+v+')');process.exit(1)}fs.writeFileSync('bookmarklet.txt','javascript:'+m);fs.copyFileSync('highlight-tool.min.js','docs/highlight-tool.min.js')"
